description: Embed the query asset, query an on-disk AssetEmbeddingIndex, and return the top-K nearest neighbors by cosine similarity. The index must have been built by `spatialpack index build` (or the equivalent core helpers); pass its sandbox-relative path. K defaults to 5. Read-only — does not modify either the query or the index.

exclude_self.description: Skip the exact-id self-match when the query is itself in the index.

index_path.description: Sandbox-relative path to the serialized AssetEmbeddingIndex JSON.

name: find_similar_assets
title: Find top-K visually-similar assets via SPEC-0087 embeddings
